scope: Runtime RUM/SLO schema recovery and native protected-delivery learnings proven during the 2026-09-01 repair cycle.

failures.symptom: A production migration failed because it attempted to create an index on brain_runtime_slo, which is a PostgreSQL view.
failures.rootCause: Information-schema column inspection plus absence of triggers/routines was incorrectly interpreted as table-backed missing aggregation. pg_class and pg_get_viewdef later proved brain_runtime_slo already existed as a canonical view over brain_runtime_metrics.
failures.failedApproach: Infer storage architecture from columns and missing triggers, then add table/index/trigger/upsert machinery without checking relation kind and view definition.
failures.provenFix: PR #942 preserved the existing view architecture with CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW; production migration runtime_slo_existing_view_matched_samples applied successfully and independent readback confirmed relkind=v.

failures.symptom: The pre-existing view counted every cached_ms and interactive_ms row together, overstating complete SLO sample coverage.
failures.rootCause: count(*) treated heterogeneous metric rows as independently complete observations.
failures.provenFix: Production view now reports samples as LEAST(cached_ms count, interactive_ms count) while retaining p95 computation from genuine persisted metrics only.

failures.symptom: PR #939 was green on its exact head but GitHub refused merge with required status check test expected after main advanced.
failures.rootCause: Native branch protection requires the candidate branch to be current with main; raw PR state was mergeable_state=behind, and the available connector has no update-branch merge action.
failures.failedApproach: Retry the same merge on the unchanged behind head after checks were green.
failures.provenFix: Compare main drift first, prove no file/contract overlap, close the behind PR as superseded, replay the exact delta from current protected main, rerun gates and merge the fresh candidate by expected head SHA.

failures.symptom: The first runtime-SLO migration was rejected due to the view/table mismatch.
failures.provenFix: Treat the failed apply as non-success, independently read back schema state, correct source through protected PR delivery, then apply a new valid migration and verify the production definition.

openObligations.requirement: Only genuine authenticated portal/browser sessions may create runtime metrics. Keep RUM/SLO NOT_PROVEN until real samples exist and the minimum matched-sample contract is met.
Replay this exact semantic learning bundle once via BG168->BG166 when Make becomes executable. Do not retry while the organization/team remains paused.

crossCuttingInvariants: Inspect relation kind and canonical view definition before DDL against an existing database relation.
Absence of triggers does not prove absence of derived state; views and materialized views must be inspected.
A protected PR that is behind current main is refreshed or superseded, not repeatedly merged.
Runtime evidence remains real-user-only; migration correctness is not RUM proof.
